CustomField.description: Internal concurrency guard: normalized 18-character Contact__c + ":" + Shared_To__c, populated only while the episode is Active and cleared to null on revoke. Unique so two Active episodes cannot exist for one direction. Salesforce unique indexes permit multiple nulls, so revoked history is not blocked. The trigger, not field requiredness, rejects an Active row without a key.
CustomField.label: Active Pair Key
